answer: Proof of Personhood protocols resist Sybil attacks by requiring cryptographic verification of unique human biology, effectively creating a gale of entropy that prevents automated bot farms from scaling. Much like life surviving in a harsh tundra, these networks filter out synthetic identities by mandating periodic biometric snapshots. By tethering influence to a scarce physical violet token of human uniqueness, the system forces attackers to bear the prohibitive capital cost of hiring real humans to bypass authentication.
